Assembly Instructions: Bookcase Model K2

Before you start, check that all 24 screws and 4 shelves are in the box. You will need a Phillips screwdriver.

Attach the side panels to the base first, then slide in the back board. Do not fully tighten the screws until all shelves are in place.

Fix the bookcase to the wall using the safety strap provided. Never stand on the shelves.
task: Summarize these instructions in two sentences.
